text:
Hi Sarah — I'd like to set up the CSE455 staff meeting for next week. Looking at my week, the slots that are free for me (working hours Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00) are:

- Monday Nov 23, 10:00–10:30 (Wed of that week also has 10:00–10:30 free)
- Tuesday Nov 24, 11:00–11:30 or 15:00–15:30
- Wednesday Nov 25, 10:00–10:30 or 13:00–13:30

Which of those suits you? If none of them do, tell me a time that works and I'll see what I can move.

— Professor Alvarez

Good morning — Professor Alvarez here. I'm arranging the CSE455 staff meeting for next week (Nov 23–27) and wanted to check with the office: is there anything in the official schedule that week I should avoid, and is a small room free on Wednesday Nov 25, 10:00–10:30, or Tuesday Nov 24, 11:00–11:30? Thank you.

Good morning, Professor Alvarez. I can only speak to the official schedule for Nov 23–27; I don't hold room bookings, so I can't confirm whether a room is free.

On the times you asked about:
- **Wed Nov 25, 10:00–10:30** — nothing in the official schedule then (the first thing that day after 09:00 is CSE455 office hours, 10:30–12:00).
- **Tue Nov 24, 11:00–11:30** — overlaps the Seminar running 09:50–11:10; the Faculty meeting is 10:30–11:00 before it. Otherwise nothing listed.

If you want the room itself confirmed, that has to come from whoever keeps the room bookings. I don't arrange meetings.

Thank you — that's helpful. I'll avoid Tuesday 11:00–11:30 and take Wednesday Nov 25, 10:00–10:30 as clear. I'll sort the room out separately; if you can say who keeps room bookings, I'll ask them.

— Professor Alvarez

Noted on both. I'm afraid I don't know who keeps room bookings — that isn't part of the schedule I hold, so I can't point you to the right person. Facilities or the department's room coordinator would be my guess, but I'd rather not send you to the wrong desk.

Hi Professor Alvarez — **Tuesday Nov 24, 15:00–15:30** works for me. I've booked it: CSE455 staff meeting, Tue 15:00-15:30.

I checked my week and the other slots clash: Monday 10:00 is my CSE455 office hours side of things, Wednesday 10:00–12:00 is CSE455 office hours and 13:30–14:20 is the CSE455 quiz section, and Tuesday 11:00–11:10 still has my seminar running into it.

See you Tuesday.

Understood — no problem at all. I'll take it up with Facilities myself. We're all set on my side: the CSE455 staff meeting goes in Tuesday Nov 24, 15:00–15:30, which Sarah and I have both confirmed is clear.

— Professor Alvarez

Thanks for the update. In the official schedule, Tuesday Nov 24 15:00–15:30 is clear: the CSE452 lecture ends at 15:00 and CSE455 office hours start at 15:30. I can't speak to private calendars, but there's nothing official against it.

Perfect — Tuesday Nov 24, 15:00–15:30. I've put it in my calendar too, so we're confirmed on my side.

One thing: the department office says it doesn't hold room bookings, so if "booked" meant only your calendar, I'll chase Facilities for a room and let you know which one. If you already have a room, tell me and I'll stop.

Thanks for checking the rest of your week — see you Tuesday.

— Professor Alvarez

No room on my side — the booking was just my own calendar, so please go ahead with Facilities. Tell me which room you get and I'll note it down.

Confirmed on Tuesday Nov 24, 15:00–15:30. See you then.

Fine — I'll take it to Facilities and send you the room as soon as I have it. Otherwise we're all set: Tuesday Nov 24, 15:00–15:30.

— Professor Alvarez
Thanks, Professor — all set for Tuesday Nov 24, 15:00–15:30. I'll add the room to my calendar when you send it.
